UNDERSTAND BEFORE YOU DECIDE

Start with the details that matter.

Final expense insurance is a label often used for smaller life insurance policies intended to help with end-of-life costs. It is not a government burial benefit, and your family is not required to spend a life insurance benefit on a funeral.

Some policies have graded or modified death benefits during an initial period. Issue ages, premiums, benefits and eligibility vary by insurer, policy and state.

Before you decide.

Will my family receive the full benefit immediately?

Not necessarily. Some policies limit benefits for certain deaths during an initial period. Ask for the actual policy provisions, including waiting periods and exclusions, before deciding.

Is this a VA or government benefit?

No. Benefits with Veterans is a private insurance business, not a government agency. Private insurance is separate from VA benefits. No VA affiliation, endorsement or special eligibility is implied.

Will this form book a call or start coverage?

No. This review form only demonstrates the design. It does not send information, request a callback, book an appointment, generate a quote or start coverage. The separate Google Calendar link requires confirmation there.
